notes.title: 《Yokai Art : Endless Four Seasons DLC》has been released！！！
notes.content:
Thank you so much for waiting.
We are happy to announce that our very first DLC Yokai Art: Endless Four Season is now officially available.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2256730/Yokai_Art__Endless_Four_Seasons_DLC/


The new evil portal has opened, Hiro and the team is ready to go and fighting with Yokai. Will it be a trap? or can they overcome all the dangerous Yokai?
[list]
[*] 4 new main characters
[img]https://i.imgur.com/85Gk2gj.png[/img]
[*] 1 New support character
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5TiSAuB.gif[/img]
[*] Additional 4 Map and Content to unlock

[img]https://i.imgur.com/njuUxMh.gif[/img]
[*] A brand new game mode with lot of fun and great reward await

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dw5IelP.png[/img]
[/list]

Hope everyone enjoys and have fun!!!

Join our social channels for further Information:
Discord: https://discord.gg/3s45MHvAmk

Hope everyone play it and supports us by clicking Follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/secret_labo/]DEVELOPER PAGE[/url] to suppose us.
